record.hypothesis: Across all four datasets, replace forward ordinal position IDs with reverse ordinal IDs over nonpadding tokens: the rightmost token receives position 1, its predecessor 2, and padding 0. This anchors positions to recency across variable-length histories and gives the appended prediction mask position 1. Apply the same rule during masked-target training and prediction. Preserve position-table dimensions, observed-history truncation, embeddings, bidirectional backbone, masked-state readout, scoring, loss and optimizer; retain one model per category.
